name: BatchCore
purpose: Async batch executor with per-item timeout, bounded parallelism, and two isolation modes (all-or-nothing / best-effort). Guarantees result order aligns with input order regardless of completion order.
invariants: BATCH_CORE_INV_01: The returned `list[BatchItemResult]` MUST be the same length as the input `items` list and aligned by index (result[i] corresponds to items[i]).
BATCH_CORE_INV_02: In `all_or_nothing` mode, the FIRST item with status_code >= 400 MUST stop subsequent processing; all remaining items receive a 409 rollback placeholder.
BATCH_CORE_INV_03: In parallel strategy, concurrency MUST be bounded by `max_parallel` — the semaphore acquires at most that many permits simultaneously.
